h1: Custom Bag Badge ID Holders for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Bag Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom bag badge ID holders in bulk. Durable, clear vinyl pouches with attachment options. Perfect for events and daily use.
introHtml: When you need badge ID holders that attach directly to bags, backpacks, or gear, our Bag supplier collection delivers practical solutions. These holders feature clear vinyl pouches with hang holes, bulldog clips, or pin attachments for secure mounting. Ideal for tradeshow staff, field workers, or event volunteers who need hands-free badge display without lanyards. Choose from sizes like 3" x 5" or 4" x 6" to fit standard ID cards. Decorate with full-color printing on the badge for brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom bag badge ID holders with clear vinyl pouch and bulldog clip attachment for bulk orders
